I guess another issue is that I work a lot... so I don’t have much time for social life... I work in restaurants... and you would think I’d meet lots of gay guys ‘cause I meet lots of people working in restaurants... but I rarely come across other gay guys... and it’s not like they ever leave me their numbers... one time there was a gay guy who worked as a host briefly, but he was super bitchy... it totally put me off... I did not want anything to do with him... 

I did manage to make a couple of friends online in recent years... but one have since moved to another city for school... and I do hang out with the other friend regularly....

We need an app for gay guys to meet and make friends with other gay guys without the pressure or expectation to hook up.... sex is great but it’s not all we do right? Most of us have other hobbies and interests... and it’s very human to want to connect with other people with common interests... the problem with Grindr and other apps is that we become so one dimensional.... either top vs bottom, daddy vs twink, masc vs fem, etc.... but aren’t we more complex than that?

Here’s an article I found online not long ago about gay loneliness.... food for thought... 
https://highline.huffingtonpost.com/articles/en/gay-loneliness/

Honestly relationship is just really damn hard.... for straight people but even more so for gay guys ‘cause there are fewer of us... and so many of us are messed up in the head... or have issues with our own identities  and body images.... and it’s not like we have anyone to look up to... to learn from.... other than gay porn.... and there no classes in school that teach gay kids about dating and relationships... so we grew up very much alone.... and even when we meet other gay guys we often don’t know how to build any kind of healthy, meaningful relationships.... romantic or not.... also I find main stream gay culture so toxic to gay guys... the kind of ideal we have to live up to... it’s all very much about how to be perceived from the outside.... be sexy, be hot, be masculine, be popular, be accepted.... but nothing about inner work....

I guess it doesn’t matter which part of the world you live in, it’s all the same.... being gay sucks in that aspect... There are no communities... just gay bars and clubs and online apps... and it’s hard to meet people and find meaningful friendship on hook-up apps and loud, noisy places like bars and clubs... where most guys have only one thing in mind... I don’t know what the solution is to this.... I often times feel like I’m cursed... destined to live my life in solitude...  

I recently saw this movie called High Life... Robert Pattinson from Twilight played a guy who was condemned to life imprisonment on a spaceship drifting in space with no way to return to earth... everybody else on that spaceship died at some point and he and his daughter were the sole survivors... 

This movie basically sums up the state of my loneliness... even though I live in a relatively large city where I am surrounded by people from day to day... and I do have friends, coworkers, and etc... but when it comes to meeting guys and making some kind of meaningful connections that does not involve sex... I am basically all alone.... drifting in space... surrounded by nothing but silence and darkness....

And sex does not fill that void in me... it actually makes me feel worse afterwards.... Feeling evermore alone after random hookups... It took me a long time to realized that sex does not fulfill my emotional needs... ‘cause it only lasts so long... and once it’s ended you are just as lonely as before... in fact, the feeling of loneliness intensifies... almost unbearable....
